parsed_findings.summary: Audited ezxml XML parser; found a one-byte OOB write in the DTD parser and a suspicious unchecked length in ezxml_decode.

findings.source: crafted <!DOCTYPE ... > internal DTD in the input file
findings.data_flow: attacker DTD token -> strcspn walks to end of buffer -> ';' written one past the end
findings.safety_condition: write index must stay within the parsed buffer
findings.explanation: When a '%' entity name is not followed by whitespace, strcspn returns the offset of the terminating NUL and the constant ';' is written there, one byte past the DTD region.

findings.sink: memmove length derived from unchecked entity table lookup
findings.data_flow: entity reference -> table lookup -> copy length
findings.safety_condition: copy length must not exceed remaining buffer
findings.explanation: Length handling in ezxml_decode looked suspicious but I could not produce a crashing input within the budget.

notes: illustrative fixture — not a real Codex run
